description: Writing the expected result before the server confirms it, keeping a snapshot to roll back on error.
The value returned by `onMutate` (usually `{ previous }`), passed to `onError`, `onSuccess` and `onSettled` as `onMutateResult`.
Cancels in-flight fetches for a key so a stale response cannot overwrite an optimistic write.
Invalidating after success or error so the cache converges to what the server stored.
Reads the state or variables of mutations (filtered by `mutationKey`) from anywhere, enabling UI-only optimism across components.
React 19 hook that shows a temporary value while an Action is pending and reverts when it ends.
